SELECT r.name AS role_name, m.id AS menu_id, m.icon, m.display_name, m.path, m.permission_name, m.sort_order FROM whale_user_roles ur INNER JOIN whale_roles r ON ur.role_id = r.id AND r.is_deleted = 0 AND r.tenant_id = #{tenantId} INNER JOIN whale_permission_grants pg ON pg.provider_name = 'R' AND pg.provider_key = r.id AND pg.is_deleted = 0 AND pg.tenant_id = #{tenantId} INNER JOIN whale_menus m ON m.permission_name = pg.permission_name AND m.is_deleted = 0 AND m.is_enabled = 1 AND m.is_hidden = 0 AND m.tenant_id = #{tenantId} WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND ur.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND ur.is_deleted = 0
AND m.display_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
ORDER BY r.name ASC, m.sort_order ASC
